subject: Anatomy

questions.question: A needle is inserted into a particular space to withdraw CSF in an adult as shown below. At which level does this space terminate?

suspectLines.text: The procedure shown is a lumbar puncture. The needle is introduced into the subarachnoid space, which ends at the lower border of the S2 vertebra. A lumbar puncture can be done anywhere from L1 to S2 vertebrae; beyond S2 there are only meninges. However, lumbar puncture is most commonly performed at L3 or L4.
